Preserve the native 0.7 m walk-height body, resource IDs, positions, heights, harvest targets, stock, partial/exhausted states and existing visibility distances. Check the actual player/head/work envelope; do not add collision to crown mass.

tasks.title: Reduce setup time and asset residency

Apply measured, bounded presentation-side reuse/loading changes. Prefer sharing equivalent resources and avoiding unnecessary eager loading; do not remove work states, blank visible assets, reduce native world density/streaming distances or weaken safety to make the benchmark faster.

Distinguish exact duplicate PNG disk bytes from loaded GPU allocation. Preserve material colour spaces, visible detail, state transitions and native work ownership. Do not silently rebuild meshes from a newer main game/data revision.

Deliver change records and application instructions suitable for combination with R1/R3/R7. Your package starts from the common G1 baseline, not an unfinished peer runtime. Include an inventory of files/functions/settings that may overlap their art edits.
Correct the cost-summary range-separator encoding only in your new measurement derivative; preserve the sealed G2 report.
checks: Record at least three paired fresh processes per mode/backend after import; report each setup duration and min/median/max. Keep import time separate from already-imported startup, first-use stalls, traversal spikes and settled frames.

Use both renderers, the same paid checkpoint/cameras/resources, 1440x900, 4x MSAA, vsync off, 120 warmup and 300 samples per camera/light. Run benchmarks alone under the mutex with no concurrent imports, generation or captures.

Report before/after texture/buffer allocations, unique resident geometry including hidden stages, disk package size and actual engine/device identifiers. Show repeatable improvement over measured variation; no approved minimum-hardware budget is invented.

Exercise cold first-use, all work stages, pause/block/cancel, partial/exhausted restore, repeated home/route reload and release/re-entry. Preserve final-hook art-on/art-off ownership and geography; replay affected source checks.
Supply matched actual images for visual equivalence. Target-device acceptance remains explicitly unverified until the owner selects and the worker actually tests that device.
